title: Add Android cartridge save backups
changes: Capture up to two ROM- and save-file-scoped, SHA256-verified cartridge backups on load and provide a confirmed restore that prepares a clean machine and atomically replaces the current save.
Refuse invalid-size startup saves, damaged or stale backups, and failed restore writes without replacing the live machine.
validation: Serial Android Rust suite passed 35 tests with 2 ignored in android-save-backup-isolation-lhvx0kvw, including rotation, synthetic restoration, tampering, failed replacement and ROM/save isolation.
ARM64 Docker build and 29 Kotlin tests passed in android-save-backup-final-apk-7ttxwbla; updated the connected moto g34 5G with adb install -r.
limitations: On-device startup, visual menu and restoration with a real cartridge save have not been exercised. Android still uses one shared primary save when switching ROMs; backup association reflects the loaded ROM and cannot prove the origin of the shared file.
